issues.title: DZ-41 Epic: M1 Fundable Beta (money + persistence + stability)
issues.body:
Tracking epic for the current focus milestone. Exit criteria = the M1 Definition of Done: an alpha streamer can self-fund a balance and run a real drop that cannot overspend, cannot lose money to escrow rollback, does not crash on end-live, and is fully persisted + audited.

**Dependency spine:** DZ-07 -> DZ-02 finish -> DZ-06 / DZ-06b -> DZ-05 -> DZ-01 / DZ-08 -> wire Epic C. Frontend (DZ-04 finish, DZ-22, DZ-23) runs in parallel and only blocks on DZ-08 for real-data wiring.

**Definition of Done (8 of 9 open as of 2026-08-01):**
- [x] Top-up backend lands as persisted, spendable balance (DZ-03)
- [ ] Top-up completes from the UI (DZ-04 finish)
- [ ] Concurrent triggers cannot overspend (DZ-02 finish / DZ-06)
- [ ] Cancelled trade refunds the ledger (DZ-06b)
- [ ] end-live does not crash (DZ-07)
- [ ] Every drop has a Drops + DrawAudit row (DZ-01 drops half / DZ-08)
- [ ] Fee hook configurable, held at 0% (DZ-05)
- [ ] dotnet test green with spend/end-live coverage (DZ-10)
- [ ] No user-visible mock numbers where a funded streamer navigates (DZ-13/14/15/17)

issues.title: DZ-30 Rotate exposed CI/bot credential committed to the production repo
issues.body:
**`P0` `security` `live incident` — do today.**

A reusable CI/bot credential was committed as an inline literal to the production repository and pushed to a public remote. Because it is reachable in git history, it must be treated as compromised regardless of whether it is currently active (it cannot be verified as inactive without using it).

Specifics (files, line references, commit, and the exact credential in question) are intentionally kept out of this public tracker and are recorded in the **internal security note** — see the private incident doc, do not paste them here.

**Remediation:**
- [ ] Rotate/revoke the credential at its source and issue a fresh one
- [ ] Purge it from full git history (git-filter-repo / BFG) and force-push all affected branches
- [ ] Add the offending dotfile(s) to `.gitignore` so they are no longer tracked
- [ ] Replace every inline literal with an env-injected reference (`${...}`) supplied at deploy time
- [ ] Sweep the repo for any other committed secrets and rotate as needed

**Acceptance:** credential no longer present in any commit reachable from a public branch; services read it from injected env; a secret-scanner pass on history is clean.

> Per repo policy: never paste secret values, tokens, or exact locations into this public roadmap. Reference the internal security note for detail.

issues.title: DZ-07 end-live crashes on every call (NullReferenceException)
issues.body:
`StreamLiveManager` uses `_streamerStateStore` but it is never constructor-injected/assigned, so `POST twitchStreaming/end-live` throws a NullReferenceException every time. Streamers cannot cleanly end a session.

**Fix:**
- [ ] Inject `IStreamerStateStore` into the `StreamLiveManager` constructor and assign the field
- [ ] Add a regression test that calls end-live and asserts no NRE

**Where:** `Application/Services/TwitchServices/StreamSessionService/StreamLiveManager.cs`.

**Acceptance:** end-live returns success against a live session; regression test green in CI.

issues.title: DZ-02 Overspend guard on the balance deduction (TOCTOU double-spend)
issues.body:
The persisted balance ledger shipped (StreamerBalances + WalletTransactions; survives restart) — this ticket is the **remaining overspend finish**, the single most dangerous open bug.

**Confirmed reachable, not theoretical:** concurrent GSI POSTs run the orchestrator in parallel with no per-streamer lock, over a **stale cached** balance held across an up-to-5-minute delivery poll, and the debit lands afterward with **no `>= 0` floor guard**. It will fire near balance depletion and drive the balance negative.

**Fix:**
- [ ] Make the deduction an atomic delta with a floor guard (`WHERE AmountUsdMinor + delta >= 0`)
- [ ] Add a row-lock or optimistic-concurrency + retry on the deduct
- [ ] Re-read balance inside the transaction (never trust the session cache for the spend decision)
- [ ] Money-path test: two concurrent triggers near depletion cannot overspend; balance never goes negative

**Note (DZ-12 link):** any lock added here only holds within one process — keep to a single backend instance until state moves to DB/Redis.

**Acceptance:** concurrent-spend test proves no overspend; balance survives restart (already true).

issues.title: DZ-06 Orchestrator money-flow hardening: atomic check+deduct + no double-delivery
issues.body:
Two money-flow defects in `GiveawayOrchestrator` / delivery path beyond the DZ-02 floor guard.

**(a) Non-atomic check-then-deduct:** balance is read from the session cache, then the purchase runs, then the debit is written — a classic TOCTOU. Fold the check + deduct into one transaction (pairs with DZ-02).

**(b) Double-delivery on timeout:** `WaitForDelivery` TimedOut falls through to the next candidate in `BuyAndDeliver`, so a slow-but-successful purchase plus the retry can deliver **two** skins for one deduction. Add idempotency via `custom_id` so a retry cannot re-buy.

- [ ] Check + deduct in a single transaction
- [ ] Idempotent purchase keyed on `custom_id`; timeout path cannot double-buy
- [ ] Money-path tests for both

**Acceptance:** timeout path never double-delivers; deduction is atomic with the balance check.

issues.title: DZ-06b Escrow is not delivery: refund the ledger on trade rollback
issues.body:
**Confirmed money-loss, not premature-only.** The delivery path counts Steam state 11 (InEscrow) / op `"hold"` as Completed and irreversibly debits the streamer within the 5-minute poll. Escrow is **not** a delivery guarantee — it can EscrowRollback (Steam Support / cancelled hold / failure) up to **15 days** later, returning items to the marketplace while the winner gets nothing and the streamer stays debited. There is no re-poll and no refund path -> permanent loss. A nullable `steam_trade_offer_state` also falls through to the `"hold"` branch, debiting before any offer is accepted.

**Fix (choose one, plus refund):**
- [ ] Poll to a terminal state (3 = Accepted only) before debiting, OR write a pending-delivery row settled on a confirmed-delivered signal
- [ ] Guard the nullable state so it cannot fall through to the `"hold"` branch
- [ ] **Refund-on-rollback:** a rollback creates a refund ledger row and marks the drop failed
- [ ] Money-path test: cancelled/rolled-back trade -> refund row + failed drop, streamer made whole

**Acceptance:** a rolled-back trade never leaves the streamer debited; delivery is only counted on a terminal Accepted/confirmed signal.

issues.title: DZ-05 Fee hook (dormant, ship at 0%)
issues.body:
There is no fee logic anywhere in the codebase today — the orchestrator deducts exactly the purchase price. Add a `PlatformFeePct` config applied at deduction, shipped at **0%**, so turning revenue on later (the ~10% service fee per the business model) is a config change, not a release.

- [ ] `PlatformFeePct` config value, default 0
- [ ] Applied at the deduction point in the orchestrator
- [ ] Unit test proving 0% == price and a non-zero value applies correctly

**Acceptance:** fee is a single config knob; 0% today; documented for the pricing flip at M3.

issues.title: DZ-08 Persist every drop (orchestrator write-path) — KEYSTONE
issues.body:
**The single keystone.** Today `StartGiveaway` draws a winner, buys+delivers, debits the balance — and persists **nothing** (the result is only logged). That missing write-path is the root cause behind most placeholders: dashboard stats/feed, history, profile Statistics/Prizes, and viewer my-drops all have no data to show. It is already on the P0 money track (required for the "no mock numbers" DoD).

**Depends on DZ-01 (Drops/DrawAudit entities).**

- [ ] Orchestrator writes a Drops + DrawAudit row per giveaway `{timestamp, channel, winner, trigger, skin+rarity, rewardUSD, tradeStatus, deliveryState}`
- [ ] Switch winner pick from `new Random()` to a seeded/crypto draw; record entrant count
- [ ] Honor or hide `WinnersCount` per decision DZ-D3 (recommendation: draw 1, hide the input for M1)
- [ ] Streamer-scoped and viewer-scoped paginated read endpoints

**Acceptance:** every drop is queryable; "was it fair?" is answerable from the audit row. Unlocks DZ-13/14/15/17.

issues.title: DZ-03 Wallet backend: OpenSettle top-ups (SHIPPED)
issues.body:
**Done and verified in code (2026-07-10..22).** `GET /wallet`, `POST /wallet/top-up` -> hostedUrl, and a signature-verified + idempotent + `fullySettled`-gated webhook that credits the ledger async. Matches the rev2 amount-only spec (amount-only DTO, server-pinned chain/token, one `/checkouts` call, no customer/invoice). ~25 money-path tests on Testcontainers Postgres.

Evidence: `WalletController.cs`, `WalletService.cs`, `OpenSettleService.cs`, `OpenSettleWebhookVerifier.cs`.

**Open ops follow-ups (tracked elsewhere):** supply live `OPENSETTLE_API_KEY / WORKSPACE_ID / WEBHOOK_SECRET`; confirm the settlement rail (code pins `ethereum/USDT`, rev2 spec says `USDC/base`) and the min bound (fix the `$0.01` min below OpenSettle's floor) before a live top-up.

issues.title: DZ-43 DECISION: no casino monetization on any surface (permanent)
issues.body:
Recorded standing decision so it is not re-litigated. **Verdict: NO on any surface, permanently** — and the "walled-off cash-casino NewCo" escape hatch is a **licensing dead-end** for the US/UK/EU audience, not a post-beta option.

**Why (platform-survival, not ethics):**
- Twitch bans promotion/sponsorship of skins gambling by name; surfacing a skin casino on-stream (co-brand, affiliate link, referral code) risks OAuth-app revocation + participating streamers suspended.
- Valve can revoke Steam API access "at any time, for any reason, without notice" — and has, for association.
- The affordable offshore license (Curacao/Anjouan) is geo-blocked out of exactly this audience; the license that reaches them (US state-by-state + UKGC) is millions and closed to skin/crypto casinos; serving unlicensed is criminally exposed.
- Casino upside = f(installed base). With ~0 activated streamers today, the near-term realizable figure is ~$0 — there is no cheque to resist.

**Standing rule:** no casino co-brand, affiliate link, referral code, or sponsor readout on any Twitch/Steam/product surface — ever. Do not reopen without gambling counsel confirming a license that legally reaches the audience.

This issue is `parked / wontfix` by design — kept open only as the visible decision record.
